author: nayibbukele
text:
🇸🇻 Elon cheered Bukele for putting 8% of El Salvador’s economy into schools!

Bukele says that starts next year, about $3B, plus 50,000 scholarships already in motion.

This year’s education budget is still around $1.68B.

The Assembly has until 30 September to see if 2027 actually carries that load.

The crime half of the story is already on the board.

Killings went from 6,656 in 2015 to 82 last year and 42 so far in 2026.

That is the crackdown people mean when they talk about a 98% drop from the old peak.

Elon has been in this for a while, and xAI is already in Salvadoran classrooms.

Bukele’s pitch now is simple: the gangs are in prison, so spend the peace on kids. The best bet for the future.

Source: El Mundo / Writer: Lucas
